facts.value_text: BofA Rewards Member tier adds 10% to eligible Bank of America card rewards
facts.title: BofA Rewards
facts.snippet: Member tier applies below $30,000 of qualifying Bank of America and Merrill balances and adds a 10% eligible-card rewards bonus.
facts.notes: Requires an eligible Bank of America checking account and eligible credit card; credit approval and program terms apply.

facts.value_text: 3% cash back on eligible purchases with the Robinhood Gold Card
facts.title: Robinhood Gold Card rewards
facts.snippet: Cardholders earn 3 points per dollar on eligible purchases and can redeem at one cent per point as brokerage cash back.
facts.notes: Card availability, credit approval and rewards program terms apply.

facts.title: Robinhood Gold Card eligibility and cost
facts.snippet: The Gold Card has no separate annual fee but requires a $50 annual Robinhood Gold subscription.
